# routeros_ip_socks (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_socks" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) Possible values: `password`.
- `connection_idle_timeout` (String) Connection is discarded if no data is passed for some time.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defines whether SOCKS are enabled or not.
- `max_connections` (Number) Max number of simultaneous connections.
- `port` (Number) Client connections are accepted on this port.
- `version` (String) Possible values: `4`, `5`.
- `vrf` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_ip_socks.settings .
```
